name: rscrcpy-audio
description: Capture an Android device with scrcpy: picture and sound in one source.
long_description: Receives scrcpy's video and audio directly in OBS. One source = one device, and it outputs picture and sound together with a shared clock, so A/V alignment needs a single constant offset. Give the source the same name as scrcpy's --obs-video-name / --obs-audio-name. A separate audio-only source is available for sound-only scenes, and multiple devices just use different names.
